$comment: Alternative URLs to try for a channel whose own URL has died. The check step probes these for any OFFLINE channel and promotes the first one that validates; nothing is published on a candidate's say-so. Each entry records where the candidate came from, because a guess and a published listing are not the same kind of evidence and the distinction should survive in the file. Keep the lists short: this is a handful of plausible endpoints for a free-to-air channel on hosts this project already uses, not a scan.

ch-37e9ee2459.name: T Sports HD
ch-37e9ee2459.why: The only URL iptv-org lists for TSports.bd is the one this channel already has, and it has returned 404 on 18 consecutive probes. Its operator (aynaott/aynascope) is alive and serving twenty-odd other Bangladeshi channels, and uses a readable slug for some of them - tvsen5.aynaott.com/atnbangla, /banglavision, /maasrangatv - alongside opaque tokens. These are the slug forms for this channel on the same operator.
